mapper.select: SELECT current_version,enabled FROM tb_knowledge_source WHERE source_key=#{sourceKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_knowledge_source SET current_version=#{version},enabled=1 WHERE source_key=#{sourceKey}
mapper.sql:
FROM tb_knowledge_chunk c JOIN tb_knowledge_source d ON d.source_key=c.source_key AND d.current_version=c.version AND d.enabled=1 JOIN tb_knowledge_revision r ON r.source_key=c.source_key AND r.version=c.version WHERE r.valid_from<=NOW(3) AND (r.valid_until IS NULL OR r.valid_until>NOW(3)) AND (r.kind='PLATFORM_FAQ'
OR (r.kind='SHOP_SERVICE' AND r.shop_id=#{shopId})
OR (r.kind='VOUCHER_RULE' AND r.shop_id=#{shopId} AND r.voucher_id=#{voucherId} AND r.rule_fingerprint=#{ruleFingerprint})
)
mapper.select: SELECT r.source_key,r.version,r.title,r.kind,r.shop_id,r.voucher_id,r.content,r.rule_fingerprint,r.valid_from,r.valid_until FROM tb_knowledge_source d JOIN tb_knowledge_revision r ON r.source_key=d.source_key AND r.version=d.current_version WHERE d.source_key=#{sourceKey} AND d.enabled=1 AND r.valid_from<=NOW(3) AND (r.valid_until IS NULL OR r.valid_until>NOW(3)) AND r.version=#{version}
